channel.name: type
channel.description: text, voice, category, announcement, thread, stage, forum, media, dm, group_dm, or unknown for newer types, empty if it isn't known

channel.name: category_id
channel.description: Empty outside of a category, for a thread the category of its channel

emoji.name: mention
emoji.description: The emoji the way Discord shows it, like 🔥 or <:name:id>

guild.name: icon_url
guild.description: Empty if the server has no icon

guild.name: owner_id
guild.description: The ID of the user that owns the server

guild.name: created_at
guild.description: When the server was created, as a Unix timestamp in seconds

guild.name: banner_url
guild.description: Empty if the server has no banner

guild.name: vanity_url
guild.description: The custom invite link, empty if the server has none

guild.name: rules_channel
guild.description: Empty if the server has no rules channel

guild.name: system_channel
guild.description: Where Discord posts join and boost messages, empty if turned off

http_response.name: body
http_response.description: Body of the response as text

http_response.name: data
http_response.description: Body of the response parsed as JSON

member.name: display_name
member.description: The display name of the account, or the username without one

member.name: banner_url
member.description: Empty if the user has no banner

member.name: created_at
member.description: When the account was created, as a Unix timestamp in seconds

member.name: nick
member.description: The nickname in the server, empty without one

member.name: joined_at
member.description: When the user joined the server, as a Unix timestamp in seconds

member.name: boosting_since
member.description: Unix timestamp in seconds, 0 if the user isn't boosting

member.name: timeout_until
member.description: Unix timestamp in seconds, 0 if the user isn't timed out

member.name: top_role
member.description: The highest role of the user, or @everyone without roles

member.name: role_mentions
member.description: Mentions of all roles of the user, highest first

member.name: role_names
member.description: Names of all roles of the user, highest first, separated by commas

member.name: color
member.description: Color of the highest role that has one, like #5865f2

member.name: is_owner
member.description: Whether the user owns the server

member.name: is_admin
member.description: Whether the user owns the server or has the Administrator permission

member.name: permissions
member.description: Lowercased permission names, like ban_members or manage_messages

message.name: author
message.description: Empty if only the ID of the message is known, like for reactions

roblox_user.name: created_at
roblox_user.description: When the account was created, as an ISO 8601 date

role.name: color
role.description: Like #5865f2, empty if the role has no color

role.name: hoist
role.description: Whether the role is shown separately in the member list

user.name: display_name
user.description: The display name of the account, or the username without one

user.name: banner_url
user.description: Empty if the user has no banner

user.name: created_at
user.description: When the account was created, as a Unix timestamp in seconds
